'''Corrik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] at the time of the [[third Galactic War]], functioning as a Demolitionist by<ref name="Secrets" /> [[3626 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|6.3}}. Since Corrik appears in The Dark Descent, her fight with the Commander can be placed in that same [[Standard year/Legends|year]] as well.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Dodge this, Imp!|Corrik to the Commander's party|<ref name="Secrets" />}}
Corrik appears as a boss in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']] expansion. Corrik only makes an appearance in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] plotline, given that her role is replaced by [[Kodo (sergeant)|Sergeant Kodo]] in the Republic version of the story.<ref name="Secrets" />

In the Imperial storyline, Corrik, together with Republic officers [[Meinar]] and [[Osonu]], fight [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]], [[Darth Krovos]], and [[Darth Rivix]], when they arrive at the [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] [[Jedi Enclave]] to find clues regarding the whereabouts of [[Darth Malgus]]. Corrik's group is killed by the Commander's party after their confrontation.<ref name="Secrets" />
